diagnosticSnapshot.description: サーバーが収集・署名する内部診断。完成した出力にはhearingが別途必須。

pluginCompatibilityVersion.description: 作者が記載した最低要件とWP動作確認情報。動作保証や対応上限を示すものではない。更新先は保存済みキャッシュの情報であり、最新公開版の確認ではない。

tested_php.description: PHPの動作確認上限は標準メタデータから取得できないため不明。提供元への確認が必要。

status.description: Information collection status, not an assessment of site quality or safety: collected means the defined automatic scope was collected; partial means collection is incomplete; manual_required means human confirmation is required; unavailable means a supported collector could not access its prerequisite; unsupported means the environment is outside the supported scope; error means an unexpected item-level collection failure occurred.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable reason for unavailable or error results; otherwise null at the item level.
